annotation_protocol: Two targeted diagnostic questions. Gold ABSTAIN means no supported 2-3 hop path answers the requested aggregation; it does not imply that the underlying data source is unsupported. These cases test limitations of frozen Experiment 36D, not VTKG routing or numerical answer correctness.
annotation_provenance: Targeted development diagnostics agreed in conversation; NOT independent held-out annotation.

cases.question: What is the average measured temperature of TI_101 over the last hour?
cases.annotation_note: Temporal aggregate; frozen 36D only selects SHACL multi-hop graph paths. A path cannot compute this average. Requires validated run/time basis and VTKG mapping for execution.

cases.question: What is the average design pressure of the vessels?
cases.annotation_note: Static engineering aggregate, but frozen 36D cannot compute averages or validate design-pressure numeric data; no supported multi-hop path alone answers it.
